description: Poll Gate OAuth; returns pending/ok/error. [write] On ok: replace mcp_token unless linked_to_google_session is true. Pass auto_replace_binding=true to rebind exchange UID on new Gate session.

auto_replace_binding.description: If true and status is ok: when new session walletType is not gate_mcp/gate_quick, call BW POST /v1/wallet/inner/rebind (same as dex_wallet_replace_binding). Gate-native sessions are blocked without calling BW.

poll_secret.description: One-time poll secret returned by dex_auth_gate_login_start. Do not show this value to the user.

name: dex_auth_gate_login_poll
